english.title: Driving a horse drawn vehicle on the footpath
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) wilfully drove a horse drawn vehicle upon a footpath or causeway by the side of a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) made or set apart for the use or accommodation of foot passengers
english.legislation: Contrary to section 72 of the Highways Act 1835.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
wilfully drive a horse drawn vehicle
upon footpath/causeway by the side of a road
made/set apart for use/accommodation of foot passengers

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See associated offence wordings: driving motor vehicle - H4113, riding pedal cycle - H4105, driving a hand cart or barrow - H1014, driving, riding or leading an animal - H1015, ride etc an animal - H1090 and lead etc an animal - H1091.
(ii) See also H117 - driving a motor vehicle on land other than a road and H363 - drive motor vehicle on a footpath/bridle way - contrary to Section 34 Road Traffic Act 1988.
(iii) Section 72 applies to the driving of 'a carriage of any description', which includes bicycles, tricycles , motor vehicles and trailers, as well as to certain animals.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level two on the standard scale and the value of any damage caused.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
